name: Builder
title: The practical problem-solver
tagline: You see a challenge and think: let's make something better.
description: You are at your best when an idea can become something real. Builders turn curiosity into prototypes, systems, and solutions that make everyday life work better.

name: Analyst
title: The thoughtful investigator
tagline: You ask the smart questions that help everyone move forward.
description: You notice patterns, look closer, and turn information into insight. Analysts make complex problems clearer so teams can make confident decisions.

name: Innovator
title: The possibility-maker
tagline: You wonder what could be possible, then go find out.
description: You connect unexpected ideas and imagine new ways forward. Innovators use technology as a creative material for solving problems that do not have a playbook yet.

name: Connector
title: The people-powered leader
tagline: You bring the right people and ideas into the same room.
description: You make collaboration feel possible. Connectors understand people, translate across teams, and use technology to create more welcoming experiences.
